purpose: Distinct strikes, wall-climbing cycles, rear-facing human combat, and fully settled non-graphic death artwork.

prompts.actions:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game animation sprites, companion action atlas.
Create exactly 6 columns by 6 rows, 1536x1536, transparent background, 36 clearly separated full animal figures in equal cells. No grid, words, scenery, floor, cast shadows, watermark or blood. Orthographic 30-degree top-down isometric view, dark cinematic beautifully detailed hand-painted realistic fur, crisp game cutout art. All animals fit completely inside cells with transparent margin. All frames of each species have identical proportions and light from upper left.
ROWS: 1 huge charcoal silverback gorilla with muscular shoulders (no crown); 2 lean dark chimpanzee with pale face and rounded big ears; 3 shaggy rust-orange orangutan with broad cheek pads and very long arms; 4 slender cream gibbon with black face and exceptionally long thin arms; 5 olive mandrill with vivid natural red-blue long muzzle and tan mane; 6 small brown capuchin with pale face and long prehensile curled tail.
COLUMNS are anatomically distinct full-body ACTION keyframes: 1 attack anticipation with BOTH ARMS overhead, front-right view; 2 DOWNWARD SMASH with body crouching and both arms striking ground, front-right; 3 sweeping SIDEWAYS strike, body twisting and one arm extended horizontally, front-right; 4 CLIMBING wall pose viewed from BACK-RIGHT with left arm reaching high above head and right leg lifted to chest (no wall drawn); 5 opposite CLIMBING wall pose from BACK-RIGHT with right arm reaching high above head and left leg lifted to chest; 6 lying dead or unconscious sideways on ground, totally horizontal relaxed collapsed body, arms resting and legs folded, head on ground, peaceful non-graphic. ALL six rows follow exactly these six poses.
Each separate sprite retains full hands, feet, tails, face and fur. Each cell ground feet baseline at y235; collapsed sprite low in cell. Clear large differences in articulated limbs between columns. Original reusable AAA indie-game-quality sprite cutouts.

Columns repeat each soldier: 1 BACK-RIGHT THREE QUARTER aiming weapon AWAY toward upper right, face away and uniform back visible; 2 same BACK-RIGHT gun firing recoil pose (no muzzle flash), arms and shoulders lifted back; 3 front-right radio communication, one hand holding radio to ear with weapon lowered; 4 front-right throwing grenade, torso rotated and right arm extended overhead in release pose, left arm balancing.
